name: buwiz-office
description: The office editor page the broker serves, and the BetterOffice fonts the app bundles

scripts.build:office-editor: esbuild editor/editor.jsx --bundle --format=esm --splitting --outdir=editor/dist --loader:.wasm=file --loader:.ttf=file --loader:.otf=file --external:"*.png" --minify && node editor/patch-dist.mjs && for p in docx xlsx pptx; do cp -R "node_modules/@betteroffice/$p/dist/generated/" editor/dist/generated/ 2>/dev/null; done
